about.title: Why we built LowKeyDevs
about.subtitle: The story and core principles behind the fastest toolbox on the web.
about.missionText1: Developer utility tools are everywhere. But almost all of them suffer from the same issues: intrusive ads, cookie popups, slow loading speeds, and forced account registrations.
about.missionText2: We built LowKeyDevs to solve these pain points. We want it to be the first place you visit whenever you need to format JSON, generate a password, or decode base64. A clean, fast utility that simply works.
about.principleInstantText: No unnecessary loading. Paste your content, and results render immediately.
about.principleClientText: Your privacy is absolute. All computations run in your own browser; no sensitive data touches a server.
about.principleCleanText: No dark patterns, fake countdowns, popups, or aggressive tracking pixels. Trust is our biggest feature.
about.ctaText: LowKeyDevs is designed to scale to hundreds of utilities. We are continuously adding new tools. Have an idea or need a specific converter? Let us know!
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.summaryText: Your data is yours alone. We do not collect, send, save, or store any of the input values, files, text, keys, or passwords you process on our website. All processing happens entirely inside your browser via JavaScript.
privacy.sec1Text: We do not require you to create an account, register, or log in to use LowKeyDevs. We do not collect personal identifiers such as your name, email address, IP address, or physical location.
privacy.sec2Text: All operations (such as formatting JSON, generating passwords, or encoding/decoding Base64) are performed locally inside your browser's sandboxed environment. Your input strings and resulting output values are never transmitted to our servers or any third parties.
privacy.sec3Text: We do not use tracking cookies or advertising pixels. We use standard browser localStorage solely to save your design preference (light mode vs. dark mode) so that it persists when you return to the site. This preference data is saved locally on your device and is never sent to us.
privacy.sec4Text: To understand basic usage (such as total pageviews and common browser agents), we may use privacy-friendly, lightweight web analytics. These analytics do not use cookies, do not track you across sites, and comply fully with GDPR, CCPA, and PECR standards.
privacy.sec5Text: If we add tools that require server-side computing, we will explicitly mark those tools and update this policy to reflect what data is processed. For now, every tool on LowKeyDevs is 100% client-side.
tools.privacyText: All conversions and formatting happen strictly in your browser. We never save, upload, or transmit any of your text, JSON, or input data to servers.
